title: Adding and Managing Entities and Fields

blocks.text: The Agentic Security Operations Platform (Agentic SecOps Platform) data model comes with many default entity types that define and describe the data created and needed by the applications in the Agentic SecOps Platform. You can manage those entities, their attributes (fields), and their relationships to ensure that business objectives are met. To learn more, see Understanding Entity Types and Understanding the Data Model in the Agentic Security Operations Platform.

Consult your Zscaler Account team when making changes to the data model. Uninformed or well-meaning changes to the data model can affect data integrity and cause fragmented or duplicated data, which can result in operational inefficiencies or noncompliance.

For access to the data model, your assigned role must include the Read, Create, Edit, and Delete permissions under the Platform - Model Management resource. To learn more, see Creating Custom Roles and Managing User Roles.
You can add new entities when you need to track distinct objects, resources, or concepts in the Agentic SecOps Platform data model that are not otherwise covered by the default entities.
Add an Entity
To add an entity:

blocks.item: In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Configure.
In the left-side navigation, click Data Model.
Click Add Entity.
See image.
This action is irreversible. You cannot delete entities from the Agentic SecOps Platform data model. To delete an existing entity, contact Zscaler Support.
Enter a name for the entity, and click Add.
An entity is created with the following default fields: First Seen, Last Seen, Tags, Sources, ID, Locked, State, Created, Last Update, Last State Transition, Key, Name, Type.
Configure the entity's relationships, fields, unification rules, and usage within the Agentic SecOps Platform. Consult your Zscaler Account team for assistance.

blocks.text: When managing entities, you can perform the following actions:
Add a Field to an Entity
To add a field to an entity:

blocks.item: In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Configure.
In the left-side navigation, click Data Model.
For the entity you want to add a new field to, click the Add field icon.
See image.
This action is irreversible. You cannot delete fields from the Agentic SecOps Platform data model. To delete an existing field from an entity, contact Zscaler Support.
In the new field window that appears:
Field Name: Enter a name for the field.

Field Type: Select a field type from the drop-down menu. Available fields include Text, Number, Boolean, Date, Date & Time, Repeated Text, Repeated Number, Repeated Boolean, Repeated Date, and Repeated Date & Time.

blocks.text: Investigate an Entity
To view the Entity Explorer page for an entity:

blocks.item: In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Configure.
In the left-side navigation, click Data Model.
Hover over the entity you want to investigate, and click the Investigate Entity icon.
See image.
The Entity Explorer page appears. To learn more, see Using the Entity Explorer.

blocks.text: Process Entities
To run unification rules and other data manipulation functions:

blocks.item: In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Configure.
In the left-side navigation, click Data Model.
Choose one of the following options:
Process All: Click to process all entities.

Process by entity: Click the drop-down menu to select the entities you want to process, and click Apply. Select Run selected and dependent projects or Run selected projections only, and click Process.
See image.
(Optional) If processing fails, click Show Logs to open the Entity Management Runs page and review the logs.
See image

blocks.text: View Entity Management Runs
To view entity management runs:

blocks.item: In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Configure.
In the left-side navigation, click Data Model.
Click the See Logs icon.
See image.
The Entity Management Runs page appears.
On the Entity Management Runs page, you can perform the following actions:
View details of the entity management runs. You can sort each column. For each run, you can see:
Status: The status column displays the outcome of each run:
Completed: The run successfully completed without data manipulation issues.
Canceled: The run was intentionally stopped by the user.
Failed: The run encountered an error during data manipulation that prevented it from completing successfully.
Partially Completed: The run encountered some errors during data manipulation. You should manually process this run again to ensure that all data manipulation is completed.
ID: A unique identifier for the run that can be used for reference when troubleshooting run failures.

Category: The run's category displays the processing type, indicating the level of processing applied to the ingested data. All Entity Management runs are categorized as Aggregate runs, where the Agentic SecOps Platform applies data unification rules and other data manipulation processes. To learn more about other run categories, see Tracking Data Source Runs.
Triggered by: Displays who initiated the run:
System: The run was triggered by its configured schedule.
User: The run was triggered by a user clicking Process or Process All.
Run type: Indicates how the run was performed:
Agg process: A run manually initiated by a user by clicking Process or Process All on the Data Unification - Entities page, Data Unification - Fields page, or Data Model Management page.
Batched: A run initiated by its configured schedule.
Auto-batched: A run initiated as part of a platform-managed batch process.
Post manual operation: A run initiated by a user overriding a field value.
For a complete list of all run types, contact Zscaler Support.
Duration: The total amount of time the run took to complete.
Start Time and End Time: The timestamps when the run started and ended. This information can reveal potential issues with data unification and assist during troubleshooting.
Click to expand a run, and drill down into detailed logs about the completion status, duration, and start and end times for each entity processed.
See image.
(Optional) For in-progress runs, hover over the run, and click the Cancel icon to cancel the run. Confirm your choice to cancel the run instantly.
See image.

blocks.text: View Entity Relationships

Relationships between entities and their fields are defined on the Configure > Relations page. Establishing proper relations prevents orphan records and preserves the integrity of your data. It also allows you to apply referential business logic.
To learn more about establishing relations among entities and their fields, contact your Zscaler Account team.
See image.
When managing fields, you can perform the following actions:
Change Field Visibility

Field visibility determines whether a field is viewable within Unified Vulnerability Management (UVM), Asset Exposure Management (AEM), and other SecOps applications. The Agentic SecOps Platform still processes, aggregates, and runs unification rules for hidden fields.
To change field visibility:

blocks.item: In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Configure.
In the left-side navigation, click Data Model.
Change a field's visibility by performing one of the following actions:
Modify multiple fields:
Click Set Visibility.
See image.
Select the fields you want to change visibility for.
See image.
Click Show to enable visibility, or click Hide to disable visibility.
See image.
Modify a single field:
Click the field you want to change visibility for.
The field details drawer opens.
Enable or disable Visibility.
See image.

blocks.text: Manage Value Calculations

Every field in the data model has a default formula that determines what values the field will contain when data is aggregated. You can see default formulas and calculations (i.e., Python script) for each field in the field drawer. You can also review the default attribute reconciliation logic to understand how values for certain field types are calculated.

To ensure the field uses value calculations that reflect your current security landscape, Zscaler recommends using field unification rules. This provides an easy, intuitive way to modify field formulas and calculations. However, if you find that the field unification rules are limited and cannot fully define the field's value, you can modify the formulas and Python script directly within the Data Model Management page. To learn more, see Configuring Field Unification and Understanding Field Unification, Data Model, and Application Settings.
To modify the field's default data model logic:

blocks.item: In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Configure.
In the left-side navigation, click Data Model.
Click the field for which you want to manage its calculations.
The field drawer opens.

Field unification rules are the recommended way to specify field value logic, and they automatically override the default data model logic. If you have already configured field unification rules for this field, click Unlink & Override. This removes the field from field unification rules.
See image.
On the Calculation tab:
(Optional) Click Add formula and select a formula from the list, or click Create new to add your own.
See image.
The formula is added to the eval_first_seen function in the Editor.
See image.
(Optional) Enable CEL to use Python's Common Expression Language (CEL).
In the Editor field, insert a Python script.
In the Default values for exception & none cases section:
Click the If Null drop-down menu and select how null values are handled:
Set Null: Set empty or null values as Null. This option is default.
Set Value: Enter what value should be given to the empty or null value.
Fail & Set Error: Set empty or null values to error with the included error message. You can also enter a new message.
Click the If Error drop-down menu and select how errors during value calculations are handled:
Set Null: Set values as Null. This option is default.
Set Value: Enter the value text.
Fail & Set Error: Set empty or null values to error with the included error message. You can also enter a new message.

blocks.text: Preview a Field or Entity Data Model
Review a limited subset of rows to verify how data loads within your field, or inspect your data types and field properties for a given entity.
To preview an entity or field data model:

blocks.item: In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Configure.
In the left-side navigation, click Data Model.
Click the field for which you want to view its data model or its associated entity's data model.
The field drawer opens.
Click Preview.
See image.
The Model Preview page appears.
Use the filters to adjust the data model preview as needed.
(Optional) Click the Entity button to view the associated entity's data model. You can resize or sort the table columns and add filters.
See image.

blocks.text: Allow Manual Updates

Allow users to make manual changes to a field value after aggregation and unification rules have run. Manual updates might be required for flexible business use cases, and you can restrict updates to roles or resources, require rationale, or apply content verification.
To allow manual updates:

blocks.item: In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Configure.
In the left-side navigation, click Data Model.
Click the field for which you want to view its data model or its associated entity's data model.
The field drawer opens.
Click the Manual Updates tab.
Enable Allow Manual Updates.
See image.
Some fields and entities do not allow you to enable manual updates.
Enable the following settings as necessary:
Allowed Permissions: Enable to determine whether manual updates are restricted to specific roles or certain resource permissions, then select an option:
Restrict to Roles: Select which roles are allowed to manually update the field.
Restrict to Resources: Select which resources are allowed to manually update the field.
Require Reason on update: Enable to require rationale when a manual update occurs, then select an option:
Always: A reason is always required when a manual update occurs. This option is selected by default.
Specific: Select conditions under which a reason is required.
Content Validation: Enable to apply validation logic when a manual update occurs, then select an option:
Manual: Select and enter specific keywords to be checked against the manually added value. Configure content permissions to further restrict available values to certain users.
Query: Select and click the Field drop-down menu to select a field.

blocks.text: View Field Usage
To view field usage:

blocks.item: In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Configure.
In the left-side navigation, click Data Model.
Click the field for which you want to view its data model or its associated entity's data model.
The field details drawer opens.
Click the Usage tab.
Click an item under each usage section to open its associated page:
Reports: All reports that include the field.
View: All saved views that include the field.
Dashboards: All dashboards that include the field.
Data Model Fields: All data model fields that the field is included in.
Data Source Mapping: All data sources that include mapping to the field.
UI Configuration: All UI configurations that include the field.
Measurement: All calculated measurements that include the field.
Sections are only displayed if the field is currently in use.
